items.title: Musk's SpaceX is still restricting Starlink in Ukraine and the toll is rising
items.summary: Since last week, Ukraine has reported restrictions on a version of Starshield, a version of SpaceX's Starlink, hampering its military operations against Russia.
items.titleZh: 马斯克的太空探索技术公司仍在限制Starlink在乌克兰的运营，而且收费还在上升
items.summaryZh: 自上周以来，乌克兰报告称，对太空探索技术公司Starlink的一个版本Starshield的限制阻碍了其对俄罗斯的军事行动。

items.title: Uber doubles down on ChatGPT for workers after last month's layoffs
items.summary: Uber offers ChatGPT Work to 30,000 employees after layoffs. The AI tool assists with tasks like meeting briefs and data analysis.
items.titleZh: 上个月裁员后，优步在ChatGPT上加倍努力
items.summaryZh: 优步在裁员后向3万名员工提供ChatGPT Work。人工智能工具协助完成会议简报和数据分析等任务。

Rivian wants to rebuild the roads its customers drive as 3D test worlds for its self-driving system, and it just bought a 15-person UK startup called Third Dimension to do it, as first reported by TechCrunch.



The startup was founded in 2024 by a former Tes…
items.titleZh: Rivian收购初创公司，将40万个每日片段转化为3D模拟
items.summaryZh: Rivian希望将客户驾驶的道路重建为其自动驾驶系统的3D测试世界，正如TechCrunch首次报道的那样，它刚刚收购了一家名为Third Dimension的15人英国初创公司来完成这项工作。

items.title: The states with the least and most operational data centers, ranked
items.summary: The AI boom has ramped up data center development. Some states are feeling the industry's growth more than others, like Texas and Virginia.
items.titleZh: 拥有最少和最多运营数据中心的州排名
items.summaryZh: 人工智能的繁荣推动了数据中心的发展。一些州比其他州更能感受到该行业的增长，比如德克萨斯州和弗吉尼亚州。

items.title: The Dow plunges 500 points as fears of renewed Middle East fighting send oil soaring
items.summary: Blue chip stocks sold off on Friday as investors fretted over rising tensions between Iran and the US and looked ahead to the Fed's rate decision.
items.titleZh: 道琼斯指数暴跌500点，因对中东战事再次爆发的担忧导致油价飙升
items.summaryZh: 蓝筹股周五抛售，投资者对伊朗和美国之间日益紧张的局势感到担忧，并期待美联储的利率决定。

items.title: Elon Musk Just Dumped Another $76 Million Into the Midterms
items.summary: The trillionaire has given more than $445 million to Republican political groups this election cycle, as Democrats vow to investigate him.
items.titleZh: 埃隆·马斯克刚刚在中期选举中又投入了7600万美元
items.summaryZh: 这位亿万富翁在本次选举周期向共和党政治团体提供了超过4.45亿美元，因为民主党人发誓要调查他。

items.title: TikTok U.S. hunts for multiple gigawatts of computing capacity, sources tell CNBC
items.summary: The operator of the social media platform in the U.S. has sounded out opportunities to obtain capacity over the coming years.

items.summaryZh: 这家美国社交媒体平台的运营商已经探索了未来几年获得容量的机会。
